notes: AEAT Manual practico IVA 2024, Capitulo 9 'La declaracion-resumen anual. Modelo 390' (paginas 292-302), supuesto practico del senor 'X' (fabricacion de aparatos electrodomesticos, epigrafe IAE 345.1), threaded through all four Modelo 303 quarterly liquidaciones of ejercicio 2024. Each trimestre's own printed 'Liquidacion' solucion states its own 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA' and 'TOTAL A DEDUCIR': 1T (pag. 293) 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA: 23.088 euros' / 'TOTAL A DEDUCIR: 16.800 euros'; 2T (pag. 297) 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA: 21.624 euros' / 'TOTAL A DEDUCIR: 23.730 euros'; 3T (pag. 300) 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA: 22.290 euros' / 'TOTAL A DEDUCIR: 4.032 euros'; 4T (pag. 302) 'TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA: 21.414 euros' / 'TOTAL A DEDUCIR: 23.640 euros'. Summing the manual's own four quarterly totals (simple arithmetic over AEAT's own printed subtotals, not a hand-run of the registry formula under test) gives the annual resumen figures this oracle grounds: devengada anual 23.088+21.624+22.290+21.414=88.416; deducible anual 16.800+23.730+4.032+23.640=68.202; resultado anual 88.416-68.202=20.214. Each quarterly TOTAL CUOTA DEVENGADA itself explicitly sums that quarter's own printed 'Recargo de equivalencia' line (1T 1.248, 2T 624, 3T 1.248, 4T 624 = 3.744 anual), confirming the annual devengada total must include recargo de equivalencia cuota (LIVA art. 161) alongside the repercutido-general and autorepercutido-intracomunitaria components. See test_m390_2024_annual_manual_worked_example.py for the full per-quarter category breakdown (domestic-general repercutido net of same-quarter rectificaciones, recargo, autorepercutido intracomunitaria net of corrections, domestic soportado interiores, and import soportado) fed to the registry as IvaLedgerObservation rows and cross-checked against these manual-stated per-quarter subtotals before being summed to the annual figures graded here.
